owner_objective: Build and validate short-horizon Satellite gap-fillers. They use otherwise idle/free capacity, never displace an open Core, and release filler capital to a materially stronger new Core entry after point-in-time remaining-value and switching-cost comparison.

current_stage_contract.core_preemption_rule: Only a materially stronger new Core entry may reclaim the weakest Satellite, after normalized exit+entry costs and training-frozen hysteresis.
required_evidence: router HOLD/SWITCH event ledger with point-in-time scores and normalized switch costs
Satellite realized PnL and profit per occupied hour
current_stage_contract.pass_rule: Positive baseline and stress shared-account delta, no increase in Core NO_FREE_SLOT blocks, productive capacity gain and positive selected-Satellite realized PnL, followed by rejection-only real-USDC holdout and full-window pass.

capital_contract.isolated_15xC: diagnostic only; each market independently receives C
capital_contract.shared_portfolio_C: actual bot simulation; total capital is C
